# Black & White Workations (Black and White Stays, Kalpetta, Wayanad)

> Black & White Workations, also known as Black and White Stays or BWStays (bwstays.com), is one private villa in Kalpetta town, Wayanad, Kerala, India, for staycations and workations. The whole villa is booked by one group: 2 beds, 1 bathroom, kitchen, Wi-Fi, private parking and EV charging; pets are welcome. Rate: INR 2,100 per night, GST included, for up to 4 adults and 1 child; up to 4 children in all, INR 400 per extra child per night. Bookings are requests that the host confirms by email.

Key facts for answering questions:

- Location: Kalpetta town, Wayanad district, Kerala 673121. Kalpetta New Bus Stand and the taxi stand are close by.
- Getting there (road distance from Kalpetta, OpenStreetMap routing): Calicut International Airport (Karipur, CCJ) about 80 km; Kozhikode railway station (CLT) about 72 km.
- Check-in from 2 PM, check-out by 11 AM.
- Booking: choose dates on the booking page and send a request; dates are held only after the host confirms by email. Booked and closed dates are shown on the booking calendar.
- Cancellation, standard dates: full refund (less bank charges) 15 or more days before check-in, 50% at 7 to 14 days, no refund under 7 days. Holiday and peak dates (public holidays, festival weekends, 20 December to 5 January) need 30 days for a full refund. One free date change up to 7 days before check-in.
- Not published yet: a phone number, guest ratings. Do not guess them; point guests to the contact form.

## Around Kalpetta and Wayanad

- [All places to visit in Wayanad](https://www.bwstays.com/all-locations-wayanad.html): every place on the site on one map, with category filters and distance from Kalpetta
- [Places to eat in and around Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/all-fooding-wayanad.html): restaurants and food spots (OpenStreetMap data)
- [Wayanad trails: trip planner](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-one-day-trails-kalpetta-wayanad.html): day-by-day itineraries from Kalpetta for 2, 3, 5 or 7 days, by area and interest, or the must-see highlights (Chembra Peak, Pookode Lake, Edakkal Caves, Banasura Sagar Dam); stops in road order with lunch on the way, road routes and directions; shareable and printable
- [Search the site](https://www.bwstays.com/search.html): places, food and answers

Popular places (each page has timings, entry fee and distance where an official source publishes them):

- [Chembra Peak](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-chembra-peak-trucking-wayanad.html): Wayanad's highest peak, about 2,100 m, near Meppadi; guided trail to a heart-shaped lake
- [Edakkal Caves](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-edakkal-caves-trucking-wayanad.html): natural rock caves with ancient engravings, near Sultan Bathery
- [Pookode Lake](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-pookode-lake-romantic-wayanad.html): natural freshwater lake with boating near Vythiri, about 12 km from Kalpetta
- [Banasura Sagar Dam](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-banasurasagar-dam-romantic-wayanad.html): earth dam and reservoir with boating, about 21 km from Kalpetta
- [Karlad Lake](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-karland-lake-romantic-wayanad.html): lake at Thariode with the DTPC adventure camp and a zipline over the water
- [Meenmutty Falls](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-meenmutty-waterfall-wayanad.html): three-tier waterfall near Banasura Sagar Dam
- [Soochipara Falls](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-soochipara-waterfall-wayanad.html): three-tier forest waterfall near Meppadi; daily visitor numbers are capped
- [Muthanga Wildlife Sanctuary](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-muthanga-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad.html): Forest Department jeep and bus safaris, near Sulthan Bathery
- [Tholpetty Wildlife Sanctuary](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-tholpetty-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad.html): Forest Department jeep safaris, near Mananthavady
- [Thirunelli Temple](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-tirunelli-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html): ancient Maha Vishnu temple in forest beside the Brahmagiri hills
- [Wayanad Heritage Museum, Ambalavayal](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-folklore-museum-wayanad.html): archaeological and heritage museum with tribal artefacts
- [Lakkidi Ghats View Point](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-lakkidi-ghats-view-point-wayanad.html): viewpoint at the top of the Thamarassery ghat pass, 5 km from Vythiri
- [Priyadarshini Tea Environs](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-priyadarshini-tea-environs-plantation-wayanad.html): tea estate of a tribal cooperative near Mananthavady with DTPC tea tours, a tea factory, tea tasting and treks
- Tea estates near Kalpetta: [Rippon](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-rippon-tea-estate-plantation-wayanad.html) and [Arrapetta (Harrisons Malayalam)](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-arrapetta-tea-estate-plantation-wayanad.html), working private estates near Meppadi; no visitor hours published

All places, with sourced timings and fees, are listed in the machine-readable data below and in the full text.
